transcribed_question:
(a) What is the name of the passage related to the area painted 'BLUE'?
(c) What are the contents of the passage related to area painted 'BLUE'

marker.description: Blue paint applied to the inferior surface of the inferior pubic ramus, indicating the location of the obturator canal.

main_question: What is the name of the passage related to the area painted 'BLUE'?
main_explanation: The blue paint is located on the inferior surface of the inferior pubic ramus, which forms the superior boundary of the obturator canal. The obturator canal is a passage that transmits the obturator nerve and vessels from the pelvis to the medial thigh.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures passes through the obturator canal?
supporting_question.explanation: The obturator nerve and the obturator artery and vein pass through the obturator canal to enter the medial compartment of the thigh.
